Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
For the converter that is missing, it's on the DC1 group:
Unfortunately, I cannot specify which one is missing due to the algorithm, what you need to do, is confirm from the list below, which one is missing.
First thing you should check is the CAN communication cables (black and white) if they are properly attached to the connector and to the converter input:
If the problem is persisting, please try swapping this converter with the neighbor one, example, swap position/cables of TB1 and TB2.
If the problem persists, replace the converter.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
